## RQ1 — Differential expression

#### Which genes are differentially expressed between patients with complete response and patients with progressive disease following anti-PD-L1 treatment?

Suggested tasks:

-   Prepare and explore the gene-expression data, including appropriate filtering and normalization.

-   Perform differential expression analysis between responders/non-responder using DESeq2, and identify significantly differentially expressed genes

-   Visualize the results using e.g. volcano plots and heatmaps of selected genes.

-   Investigate the biological functions of differentially expressed genes and discuss their potential relevance to immunotherapy response.

-   Discuss the limitations of the analysis, including potential confounding factors and why differential expression does not necessarily imply a causal role in treatment response.

### Initial data prep

#### Load packages and data

```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)

# Load datasets
counts <- readRDS("../data/counts.rds")
clinical <- readRDS("../data/clinical.rds")
```

#### Filter data to overlapping samples

```{r}
# Check whether sample names match
identical(colnames(counts), clinical$sample_id)
```

Note that all samples are present in both datasets, therefor no filtering is needed.

#### Response as two-level factor

```{r}
clinical$BOR <- as.factor(clinical$BOR)
levels(clinical$BOR)
table(clinical$BOR)
```

#### Check

```{r}
colnames(counts) == rownames(clinical)
```

## **Build the DESeq2 dataset and run the differential expression analysis**

#### Run DESeq2

```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts,
                              colData = clinical,
                              design = ~ BOR)
```

```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts,
                              colData = clinical, # metadata; information about samples
                              design = ~ BOR) #  Overall survival (binary grouping variable);specifies which variables from colData should be included in the statistical model.
```

```{r}
# drop genes with 10 or fewer reads
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10 ,]

# run deseq
dds <- DESeq(dds)

```

#### Extract results

```{r}
# extract results
res <- results(dds)

resultsNames(dds)
summary(res)

res_sig <- results(dds, alpha=0.05)
summary(res_sig)
```

```{r}
res_df <- as_data_frame(res) |>
  mutate(significant = padj < 0.05)
```

#### Volcano plot

```{r}
ggplot(res_df,
       mapping = aes(x = log2FoldChange,
                     y = -log10(padj),
                     color = significant)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "limegreen")) +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       title = "Volcano Plot") +
  theme_minimal()
```

#### Fancy volcano plot

```{r}
res_df_2 <- as_tibble(res, rownames = "gene") |>
  drop_na(padj, log2FoldChange) |>
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Up in reponders",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Up in non-reponders",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

top_labels <- res_df_2 |>
  filter(group != "Not significant") |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 10)

ggplot(res_df_2, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Up in reponders" = "firebrick",
      "Up in non-reponders" = "steelblue",
      "Not significant" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3,
    vjust = -0.6,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = max(res_df_2$log2FoldChange), y = 0.3,
           label = "Higher in reponders \u2192", hjust = 1, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "firebrick") +
  annotate("text", x = min(res_df_2$log2FoldChange), y = 0.3,
           label = "\u2190 Higher in non-responders", hjust = 0, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       title = "Volcano Plot") +
  theme_minimal()
```
